title: Application Timekeeping Chrony Entity
description: Chrony-specific configuration. Extends Application/Timekeeping with chrony-specific settings.

makestep.description: Allow large clock adjustments on startup.

threshold.description: Seconds threshold for a step adjustment (e.g., 1.0).

limit.description: Max number of step adjustments after start (-1 for unlimited, 3 is common).

rtcsync.description: Sync system clock to RTC (hardware clock).

keyfile.description: Path to the key file for NTP authentication.

allow.description: Networks/hosts allowed to use this machine as NTP server.

deny.description: Networks/hosts denied from using this machine as NTP server.

local_stratum.description: Serve time locally even when not synchronized (stratum value).

leapsectz.description: Timezone database for leap second handling (e.g., right/UTC).
